headline: Record disbursements and lower opex lift PPOP;

highlights: AUM stood at INR 150.19 bn, flat QoQ and up 23% YoY, while H1FY27 PAT rose 53% YoY to INR 1.19 bn.
Pivot Gains Traction as Focus Book Crosses Half of AUM: Net disbursements hit a record INR 31.59 bn, up 77% YoY and 24% QoQ, with disbursements above INR 10 bn in every month of the quarter.
Portfolio yield rose 53 bps QoQ and 108 bps YoY to 18.7%, and quarterly operating cost has come down to INR 1.27 bn from INR 2.05 bn in Q4FY26, in line with FY27 guidance.

Stock Performance (%) 1m 6m 12m Ugro Capital Ltd (11.92) (30.11) (61.41) Nifty 50 11.21 5.16 (4.21) Both Growth Engines Compounding on Built Infrastructure: Emerging Market LAP AUM grew 10% QoQ and 42% YoY to INR 42.68 bn on disbursements of INR 6.92 bn, with yield of about 18.4% and GNPA of 2.0%.
valuation: Valuation and View: UGRO delivered a steady Q2FY27, with PPOP up 22% QoQ, record disbursements and the focus book crossing 53% of AUM, though higher credit costs from book seasoning kept earnings growth modest.

Management targets a steady state ROA of 3.0% to 3.5% by FY29 without fresh equity and expects profits to improve every quarter, while restated financials post merger should reduce volatility from income reversals.
At the CMP of INR 71 per share, we maintain our “BUY” rating and value the stock at 0.65x its FY29E ABV of INR 241, arriving at a target price of INR 157, an upside of 122%.
watch: The credit cost trajectory and the merger restatement remain key monitorables, and we will revisit our estimates once restated financials are published.
